title: Here is my experience making a Pokemon Roguelike with Vercel and Pi harness
author: Own-Kaleidoscope-183
selftext:
Hi I made [Poketro](https://www.poketro.com/), a balatro inspired pokemon roguelike that uses pokemon showdown and other pokemon apis for realism and extra details.

Here's some info on my experience:

\- Pi harness: i haven't tried every harness but I really like this one.  I have a dev desktop that I run with pi dev and because of the simple defaults I was able to set up a dev workflow that involves me chatting to it from my phone on tailscale and basically deving on this game from anywhere.

\- Vercel is amazing for iteration: Again so nice to easily access your project from any machine for devving, but also for sharing and publishing. I'm curious what other experiences are with creating games, but I like web games because I'm used to the development and It means I can play my game on my phone whenever I want.

\- release: I'm sure everyone here has dealt with this, but I got a lot of push back for using ai to make this game. If I had more time I may have coded this by hand, but I think through designing, debugging, and play testing I can confirm that I made a game that isn't slop, it really is the end version I sought out to make before chatting with ai once. The experience made me a bit depressed because it's hard to convince people that your ai game is still a passion project. Did anyone else have success with this?

  
Feel free to ask me any other questions on this experience.

 Also take a try at the game, if you like pokemon and balatro then I think you will really like it!

[https://www.poketro.com/](https://www.poketro.com/)

Thanks!
